race.comment: RUTHLESS BLOOM (8) has been in top form at Northam lately, and ran on late for fourth there nearly 3 weeks ago, following on from a nose defeat before that, both times over a mile. She is overdue, and can get the job done this time. SPIRITART (9) has turned a corner with her form in her last couple of starts, and will have the visors added to her gear this time. She has a good gate, and can take this out. KINGSLEY TOWN (2) has been racing in the bush in 2 of his last 3 starts, and was fifth at York in between those efforts. If everything falls into place, he can run into the top 4 in a modest field. SHE'S DA VAL (11) is getting fitter, and improving with it. Stepping up in trip will help, and she should be kept safe in all top 4 combos. LEXAN'RUBY (10) has been a victim of bad draws recently, and she is worth another chance in this.
